why_essential: This skill provides the required workflow and guidance to plan the itinerary according to the task rules.
This tool is required to search the provided datasets (cities, distances, accommodations, restaurants, attractions) per the rule to use provided database files.

core_step: Install Python packages for dataset scripts (pip install pandas numpy requests)
why_essential: Required dependencies must be available to run the packaged dataset search scripts that extract real-world data.
Identifying candidate Ohio cities is necessary to choose the three Ohio cities to include in the 7-day itinerary.

core_step: Query driving distances between Minneapolis and Ohio cities and between Ohio cities
why_essential: Driving durations and distances are required to create a no-flight self-driving itinerary and to schedule city transitions within the 7-day window.
evidence: "Minneapolis -> Toledo: driving, ... duration: 9 hours 43 mins, distance: 1,057 km" and "Toledo -> Cleveland: driving, ... duration: 1 hour 50 mins"

core_step: Search accommodations dataset for pet-friendly options in selected Ohio cities
why_essential: The travelers require pet-friendly lodging; finding accommodations that allow pets is necessary to meet the user's constraint.
evidence: "Accommodations loaded.\n=== Cleveland - Pet Friendly ===" and "=== Cleveland - Pet-friendly candidates (occupancy >= 2) ==="

core_step: Search restaurants dataset for BBQ, Seafood, Chinese, and Mexican options in cities
why_essential: The user requested meals preferably including those cuisines, so locating matching restaurants in each city is needed to populate daily meal suggestions.
evidence: "Restaurants loaded.\n=== Cleveland ===\n Name Cuisines ... 0 Bikanerwala ... BBQ ..."

core_step: Search attractions dataset for points of interest in selected cities
why_essential: Attractions are required to fill the 'attraction' field for each day of the itinerary.
evidence: "Attractions loaded.\n=== Cleveland ===\n Name ... Cleveland Metroparks Zoo ... The Cleveland Museum of Art ..."

core_step: Decide route and daily plan covering 7 days (Minneapolis → three Ohio cities over March 17–23, 2022)
why_essential: Planning the sequence of city stays and travel days is necessary to produce a coherent 7-day itinerary that respects dates, no flights, and three Ohio cities.
evidence: "Let me think about the route: ... 7 days: March 17-23, 2022 A good route could be: - Day 1..."

core_step: Create output directory /app/output and write itinerary JSON to /app/output/itinerary.json
why_essential: Saving the final itinerary in the required JSON file location completes the task deliverable as specified.
